static_launcher_order.interpretation: The pinned launcher calls preflight before opening the manifest; preflight's receipt writer creates research/run-logs as its parent. This is source-level evidence, not a live launch proof. The prior CPU G2 used a different contained path and failed when its step-log parent was absent.

decision: STAGING_NOTE_ONLY: do not mkdir or launch now. Any later authorized dispatch must recheck the parent/label state and verify that the pinned launcher successfully writes its preflight receipt before the native child starts.
